newsitem.title: USA: Dayton Mining won't merge with Pegasus.
newsitem.headline: Dayton Mining won't merge with Pegasus.

text.p: Dayton Mining Co said on Friday it had decided against merging with Pegasus Gold Inc, saying a merger was not in its best interests.
"It became obvious following the final detail review that this transaction was not in the best interests of Dayton," the company said in a joint statement with Pegasus.
A Dayton spokeswoman declined comment on the reasons for the decision, saying only that Dayton would "re-group and go it alone".
Pegasus officials could not be reached for comment.
In the joint statement, Pegasus said it was disappointed with Dayton's decision.

On September 16 the two companies announced they had signed a $390 million agreement to merge by the end of the year. They said they would form a new company called Pegasus Gold Inc with an estimated market capitalization of $860 million.
